review.head: 9869dd1be79e9e9a0fa900e3dda178f2e31664a0
review.notes: Sample: all fifteen sections 1.1-3.3, verified against the pinned libraries. All 278 README Lean names were checked at the pins (256 by #check, 22 in unbuilt modules by reading source), with hypotheses compared to the README. Every Check and example was recomputed. Sources: only Ullrich 2024 (arXiv 2405.05509v2) is legally readable and was checked against Convention 3 and the 1.1 laws; the other cited books and articles are paywalled. Automatic checks: every check passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with only the sorry warning; the one-tactic probe does not close the theorem. Findings: the universe-general OI-B72 route lacks a Hilbert space over the scalars in an arbitrary universe (none at the pins); the overview's field-generality sentence is false for OI-A24 over Q; the Layer 1 example gives rank(l2) = aleph0; MAJ-A26/B01/B31 are dropped without mapping by Majorization's open revision 591e977. The automatic overlap scan missed that last one, so the scanner may need fixing.
